profile.summary: OCCUR is a Black-led nonprofit in Oakland, founded in 1954, that works to build economic power in historically excluded communities. It runs the David E. Glover Emerging Technology Center and offers free programs in small business development, technology and digital skills training, and nonprofit capacity-building.

review.notes: OCCUR is a distinctive Oakland-based 501(c)(3) (ProPublica EIN 20-0960930, ruling 2004); the homepage confirms the Black-led description, programs, phone, email and address, and occurnow.org/about confirms the 1954 founding. The link to OUSD's Sojourner Truth contract rests on name and location, since OCCUR's pages never mention OUSD, so the match is probable but not directly confirmed.
